summary: Departmental misconduct: failure to conduct periodical inspections; incomplete security formalities; burden of proof in disciplinary proceedings; courts below improperly reappreciated evidence; standard: preponderance of evidence; charges of non-reporting excess drawings disproved; acquittal on non-submission of control forms; area of operation charge dismissed; penalty of reduction in pay upheld; judicial review limits transgressed.
legal_provisions_cited: State Bank of India (Supervising Staff) Service Rules r.49(e)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; penalty order of reduction in basic pay to lowest stage in Scale-I upheld; period of suspension treated as suspension only.
